name: gsap-performance
tagline_zh: 动画掉帧、卡顿？别靠猜。这个技能直接告诉你用 transform、避免布局抖动、批量更新，还有 will-chan。
tagline_en: Janky animations? Stop guessing. This skill gives you transform-first, layout-thrashing fixes, batching, and.
desc_en: Official GSAP skill for performance — prefer transforms, avoid layout thrashing, will-change, batching. Use when optimizing GSAP animations, reducing jank, or when the user asks about animation performance, FPS, or smooth 60fps.
why_zh: 它把 GSAP 官方性能经验固化成规则，直接指出你代码里哪一行拖垮帧率，比通用优化建议更狠更准。
why_en: It codifies GSAP's official performance rules, pinpointing the exact line causing jank—sharper than generic optimization advice.
